scheduled_maintenances.name: Interconnection Infrastructure Upgrade (IE1)

incident_updates.body:
Twilio will perform scheduled network maintenance in our IE1 region during an 8-hour window from 16 October 2026 at 14:00 PDT to 16 October 2026 at 22:00 PDT.

During this window, customers may experience a brief service interruption of up to 90 seconds affecting the following:

Interconnected Customers: All IE1 interconnected customers will experience a brief interconnection service interruption of up to 90 seconds.
